                                "total_ms": 4.19, "calling_context": "large (1 MiB or more) sequential reads, warm page cache, about native read() speed of 8 GB/s"},
                 "max_cores": 1}],
 "floor_ms": 4.19, "L_delta": -0.828,
 "rationale": "The only frozen work is fd_read of 32 MiB, about 4.2 ms on one core, well below T_R_upper of 9.59 ms (L_delta = -0.83), so I cannot certify an architectural gap. The rest of the time is CRC computation in wasm, which is mutable code (algorithm, SIMD, runtime settings). I cannot name a concrete change that reaches 12.1 ms without carry-less multiply, so this is not shown fixable either."}
